title: Stonewake Sanctuary
intro: The Stone Seal answers a steady hand.
Stand your ground and awaken the first element.
outro: Stone remembers your resolve. The drowned ruins now call.

title: Tidelost Ruins
intro: The Tide Seal lies beneath a sky of falling embers.
Flow around danger; turn every attack aside.
outro: The ruins breathe again. A path opens above the clouds.

title: Skyglass Spires
intro: The Gale Seal waits where broken towers touch the wind.
Move lightly; find the opening in every pattern.
outro: The storm clears. Far below, the Cinderforge burns.

title: Cinderforge
intro: The Ember Seal is chained to the forge-heart.
Strike with purpose before the dark can blink away.
outro: Four seals burn as one. The Eclipse Citadel is exposed.

title: Eclipse Citadel
intro: Every restored seal points to the same wound in the world.
Master Lightning. Enter Convergence. End the Rift.
outro: The seals are whole. Dawn reaches every corner of the realm.
